Maharashtra districts restrict loud DJs and laser lights during festivals

Several districts in Maharashtra have implemented restrictions on high-decibel DJs and laser lights during festivals, particularly during Ganeshotsav. These measures include a crackdown on plasma sound systems and high-intensity beam or laser lights. Shiv Sena leader Sanjay Raut has called for a state policy on the use of loud DJs and laser lights during festivals. The restrictions aim to curb excessive noise and light pollution associated with celebrations.
